task_description: VayuLok live page, cycle for requirements 05 and 06 (extends open PR #218 on branch feat/vayulok-map-right-redesign). 05: render the AQI and PM2.5 heatmap overlay in the site lime (#d1f470) and fully translucent so the geo map stays visible, removing the red cast - chosen approach documented in RESEARCH-05 (Option B: CSS filter/blend/opacity on overlay tiles, scoped, reusing --lime). 06 (bounded to the owner-approved permissible subset): keep Google Maps attribution/logo/legal AND Google Place Photo author attributions visible and legible (ToS mandatory - NOT removed); document the EXIF finding (no project-owned raster/EXIF pipeline exists; Place Photos are live-fetched so no local bytes to strip); optional minimal ToS-safe styling only. All work in src/components/VayuLokLive.tsx + src/test/VayuLokLive.test.tsx; hero page untouched. No push, no PR.

review.v1: APPROVED (.agents/tasks/vayulok-overlay-lime-attribution-20261004/2026-10-04-032552-review.md). Three non-blocking issues: (1) code comments reference a .vl-live-map-stage .vl-live-overlay-lime selector that was never shipped - fixed in a follow-up comment-only edit; (2) possible lime bleed onto Google base-map tiles because the img:not([alt]) selector can match base tiles too - fidelity nuance, not a ToS break, needs live check on *.wecare.digital; (3) lime pixels/translucency cannot be verified in CI because the browser key is referrer-restricted - flagged for manual verification on a deployed origin.

verification.summary: npm run typecheck clean; npm run lint 0 errors (203 pre-existing warnings only); npm run test 904 passed / 3 pre-existing skips, VayuLokLive suite green. Full 'npm run build' intentionally skipped (heavy Next export + generator scripts; context.json directs typecheck+lint+test as the verification path) and no Dockerfile is used for this static-export frontend. test_quality: the req-05 test asserts the ImageMapType carries a translucent numeric opacity (0<x<1) and the legend renders only while a layer is active with both ends labelled in words; the req-06 test drives the real search->select flow, resolves a Place with authorAttributions, and asserts the .vl-live-photo-credit figcaption + contributor link render with the exact href/name - both would fail if the respective code were reverted. ToS guardrail grep confirms .gm-style-cc / a[href*=google] / img[alt=Google] appear only in descriptive comments, not CSS selectors.
